beats.headline: A coupon, and a shitty helmet
beats.text: At the saferoom in a glass-fronted donut shop at station 281, Carl asks the bopca, Nodd, for the crafting table menu: a long list, most of it useless, most of it about 25,000 gold a table. He slides one of his two free table coupons forward, and spends both upgrade coupons on taking his sapper's table to level three. His book has confirmed what he suspected: armour shaped at an engineering table never counts as equipped, and if Katia cannot equip it, she cannot add it to her mass. At the new armorer's table he picks his sample's intention from the Armorer's Workshop tab. The only choice is Shitty Helmet. It looks no different, but it resizes itself slightly, and Katia can equip it.

beats.headline: An ugly backpack
beats.text: A note from Rosetta in the cookbook's bomb chapter says an equipped backpack keeps unstable satchels from going off, and two more notes under it argue the point. So Carl builds Katia one, a large metal box with reinforced dingo-hide straps, and sets it on a stand he made for it. He tells her he saw backpack listed in the armorer workshop tab, which is true; he searched until he found a way to make it look like a chance find. The system names it Ugly Ass Backpack With a Completely Useless Design that Only an Idiot Would Wear. Carl does not care, as long as the word Backpack is in there.

beats.headline: The Scrapheap Breastplate
beats.text: In the temple, Bomo stands covered in spiked armour, and apart from the shoulder pads holding up the launchers almost none of it is joined. Carl sewed the metal pieces one by one onto a fabric undershirt, with dozens of trash-tier daggers in the gaps, and putting it together at his armorer's table turned the whole thing into something called a Scrapheap Breastplate. He did the same for the arms and the legs. Donut casts Laundry Day on Bomo, and the pieces explode off him like a fragmenting grenade, filling the room with metal. Paz is bowled over by a chunk of helmet. A dagger lodges in Carl's arm; he had not realised the armour would fly off like that.

relations.note: Armour made here is armour she can equip
